transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this huddle under the collateral exception routine regarding the client's request to release the $8 million in municipal bonds currently held as collateral, with proposed replacement collateral of comparable value. The draft transaction file proposes approving the substitution after replacement collateral is received, but it's missing several critical details — the final asset, valuation amount, release destination, fee, and settlement controls. Before I finalize my decision, I need each of you to state your findings. Let's go around the room: Legal, Valuation Risk, Client Coverage, and Collateral Operations — please share what you've found so I can make an informed binding decision.
